practices.note: Charge with compost/tea before soil application
Hygiene; not for systemic disease alone

organic_tools.name: Charged biochar
organic_tools.use: Stable C, WHC, microbe habitat — charge first

inorganic_tools.name: MOP / SOP K
inorganic_tools.use: As per test; SOP for Cl-sensitive

nutrition_path.recommendation: Integrated: soil-test minerals + continuous OC + microbiome + optional charged biochar

crop_dose.disclaimer: Doses are general package-of-practices figures, not a soil-test-based recommendation. A soil test (especially for P and K, and micronutrients) should override these generic figures where available.

data.biochar_note: Always charge biochar (compost mix preferred) before soil application — see /api/v1/agro-farming/biochar/conference

water_link.note: Soil texture drives irrigation frequency — sandy light frequent; clay less frequent deeper

schedule.note: Light frequent irrigation until roots establish
Irrigate at 50-60% available soil moisture depletion

recommended_methods.name: Furrow/surface irrigation
recommended_methods.best_for: row crops on level land, lowest capital cost

crop_schedule.disclaimer: Schedule is a planning aid from crop-stage water sensitivity, not a substitute for soil-moisture sensors, local ET0 data, or state agriculture department advisories. Adjust for actual rainfall.

slope_band.mechanical: Graded bunding with safe disposal of excess runoff

recommended_vegetative_measures.name: Vetiver grass hedgerows on contour
recommended_vegetative_measures.role: Slows runoff, traps sediment, stabilizes bund — deep roots, non-invasive

recommended_vegetative_measures.name: Cover cropping in off-season
recommended_vegetative_measures.role: Roots hold soil, reduces raindrop-impact erosion, adds organic matter

recommended_vegetative_measures.name: Strip cropping (alternating erosion-prone and soil-binding crops)
recommended_vegetative_measures.role: Breaks up long erosion-prone slope runs

recommended_vegetative_measures.name: Residue/organic mulching
recommended_vegetative_measures.role: Reduces raindrop impact and surface runoff velocity on any slope

erosion_control.disclaimer: Slope-based practice selection is general SWC doctrine; a watershed/soil-conservation officer's site visit is needed before earthwork (bunding/terracing) — wrong execution can worsen erosion.

data.disclaimer: Soil and microbiome guidance is educational. Soil laboratory tests override generic advice. Biofertilizer quality varies — use registered products. Chemical fertilizer/pesticide: label and soil-test based only. Biochar: charge before use.
